title: Chelsea
creator: CrossFit
description: Every minute on the minute for 30 minutes: 5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups, 15 squats. The same triplet as Cindy but with the clock forcing a strict pace; the rest shrinks as you slow down. If you fall behind, keep going for the full 30 minutes and count rounds; if you have finished it before, add a rep to each movement.
